jobs.name: Answer compliance questions from the policy corpus
jobs.outcome: A question about what the rules allow is answered with the policy passage that says so, or routed.

jobs.name: Extract obligations and dates from signed contracts
jobs.outcome: Every obligation, deadline and renewal in a contract is extracted into the register with its clause.

jobs.name: Monitor regulatory changes that affect the business
jobs.outcome: Changes in the regulations the company is subject to are detected, summarized and mapped to the affected policies.

jobs.name: Review a non-disclosure agreement against the playbook
jobs.outcome: An incoming NDA is marked up against the company playbook, with deviations explained, before a lawyer looks.
